low_same_part_other_truck.author: SummitSierra21
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Works, but causes glitches
low_same_part_other_truck.body: The Pulsar LT was up to date, and installed in my truck exactly how the instructions directed. Unhooked the battery and everything. Navigating the settings was interesting since for some reason I would have to keep starting over almost like my truck was rejecting the unit. Once I got it to work properly and deactivated the DFM as well as the auto start/stop functions, I went to adjust tire size. All said and done I took it on a test drive to confirm everything was working correctly, which it was, except it was causing my drivers side blind spot monitor to stay on constantly. I figured maybe it was a fluke. Several hours later while driving to work, the drivers blind spot monitor came on with no vehicles/traffic, guard rails, or jersey barriers around. Literally nothing but short grass 1 lane over was on my drivers side. On the way home from work, I experienced the same issue. Hopefully it goes away but so far I like that it deactivated certain functions, but I’m not liking the electrical glitches the unit seems to be causing.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Edge Pulsar LT Inline Control Module (19-21 V8 Sierra 1500; 2022 V8 Sierra 1500 Limited)
